name: NetApp
description_en:
NetApp is a product in the Backup and recovery category. Its directory profile covers Incremental Backup, Mobile Compatibility, Web Access, Compression Option, Cloud Storage, Remote Access, Secure Data Storage, Encryption.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Large Enterprises Medium Business. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: protect data using supported cryptographic mechanisms. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
